_comment: AU-hartland P4·S4.1 — one deployment set per cluster (review-236 P2, D-139/D-174): bp-dsk runs the CZ set, the hartland cluster the US set; never both on one engine (two definitions cannot both subscribe the message start order_placed). The composer (scripts/compose-processes.py), the export recipe and the driver read the set by name. inbound/settle have no CZ twin (no money parameter), so both sets call the same two deployments.
